concepts.name: TextBook 263 Converts Including His Own
concepts.simple_definition: TextBook 263 converts including his own daughter and her husband Othman (who later became the third caliph of the Islamic state) to Aksum to seek refugee from the persecutions they were suffering in the hands of the then rulers of Mecca
concepts.deep_explanation: The Quraysh ruling classes of Mecca had sent envoys to the Aksumite king with gifts demanding the ex- tradition of the first converts who were given refugee in Aksum

concepts.name: 264 Grade 12 He Kept His Prerogatives De
concepts.simple_definition: 264 Grade 12 he kept his prerogatives despite the expansion of the Christian kingdom thanks to his friendly relations with Emperor Menilek II, to whom he nevertheless had to pay
concepts.deep_explanation: Strongly influenced by Indian architecture, the building of the palace of King Abba Ji- far II includes, on the ground floor, the family mosque and the reception room, where you can see a window higher than the others, which allowed the giant to have a view of the surrounding areas
